14 (+2)

16 (+3)

6 (−2)

Saving Throws DEX +7, WIS +6

Skills Perception +6, Stealth +10

Damage Immunities poison, psychic

Condition Immunities charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned

Senses darkvision 60 ft., truesight 10 ft., passive Perception 16

Languages understands the language of its maker; does not speak

Challenge 5 (1,800 XP)    Proficiency Bonus +3

Traits

Bloodline Sense. The Hollow Attestant can sense the presence of its designated bloodline within 300 feet, even through walls and magical concealment. At the start of combat, the DM designates one creature in the encounter as a Lineage Target. The Attestant always knows the exact location of its Lineage Target and cannot be misdirected by illusion or disguise when tracking that creature specifically.

Studied Patience. While the Hollow Attestant has not yet made an attack this combat, it has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and its movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. This trait ends the moment the Attestant makes its first attack roll.

Construct Nature. The Hollow Attestant does not require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Actions

Multiattack. The Hollow Attestant makes two Judgment Strike attacks. Both attacks must target the same creature if the Lineage Target is within reach.

Judgment Strike. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is the Lineage Target, the attack deals an additional 7 (2d6) piercing damage and the target cannot benefit from the Help action or receive healing from a creature other than itself until the start of the Attestant's next turn.

Sentence Delivered (Recharge 5–6). The Hollow Attestant makes one attack against its Lineage Target only. On a hit, in addition to normal damage, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become stunned until the end of their next turn. On a failed save, the Attestant may immediately move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

Reactions

Lineage Shield. When the Lineage Target would deal damage to the Hollow Attestant, the Attestant can use its reaction to halve that damage. It does not use this reaction against attacks from other creatures — only the one it was built to find.

The Long Observation

For up to 2 rounds after initiative is rolled, it may delay its turn, moving silently, observing. It does not act. Players who target it during this phase may attack it normally — it is not invisible, not invulnerable. It simply does not respond. It is finishing its assessment.

Phase Logic

Phase 1 — Observation: Studied Patience is active. It moves without provoking opportunity attacks and does not attack.

Phase 2 — Sentence: Studied Patience ends. It attacks only the Lineage Target unless physically prevented.

It does not pursue at a run. It pursues at a walk. It knows where the bloodline is going.

Sanctum Monster Forge
Lore

The Hollow Attestanted

Medium Construct, Lawful Neutral

Origin

It was built to find one family and end their line. Not kill them — attest to their guilt and carry out the sentence. The family is gone. Three centuries gone. The Hollow Attestant does not know.

It reads ancestry through blood and bone, and somewhere in its targeting logic, one branch survived. It has been following the trail since before anyone in the room was born.

Behavior

It does not hide to avoid being seen. It hides because observation is the first part of its work. The attack comes only when it is certain.

Players may not see it before it acts. They may feel watched first — correctly. When it does strike, it strikes one target and does not deviate.

Encounter Hooks

  • One player character has a noble surname — even a minor one, even abandoned. The DM chooses them as the Lineage Target before the session.
  • A scholar hires the party to retrieve a decommissioned construct from an old courthouse. It was not decommissioned. It was waiting.
  • The party finds a journal belonging to the Attestant's original maker. The targeted family's crime was refusing to pay a debt.

Alternate Win Conditions

Destroy It. Reduce it to 0 hit points. The Attestant does not flee, negotiate, or surrender.

Overwrite the Mandate. Access the maintenance inscription behind its left clavicle plate while it is grappled, restrained, or incapacitated. Three successful DC 15 Arcana or Dexterity (Thieves' Tools) checks wipe the target designation.

Prove the Sentence Was Fulfilled. Present proof that the original sentenced individual died by lawful means and interface with its recognition logic.

“The feeling of being watched in a room you know is empty. Not once. Every room, for three days running.”

Scene

A space the party has already passed through once — a corridor, a market street, the entrance hall of an inn. The Attestant chooses familiar ground, not dramatic ground. It does not want atmosphere. It wants angles.

The name sounds like an official designation. It probably was. Someone filed paperwork for this.
